purpose: freeze burned-pilot and confirmatory partitions before pilot response access
confirmatory_role: only partition eligible for later predictive adequacy scoring
hard_stops: pilot response already accessed before partition freeze
pilot marked for predictive effect estimation
invariants: pilot and confirmatory outcomes are never pooled
pilot failure consumes the protocol version
pilot pass authorizes only creation of a new confirmatory protocol, not target access
confirmatory response remains sealed until its own frozen protocol is merged and CI-green
relationship_to_v0_30: v0.30 defines the estimability audit; v0.31 freezes the disjoint evidence partitions before that audit can be run
